description: WAN flow analytics backed by ClickHouse flow records collected from the MikroTik gateway. Approximate geography uses GeoLite Data created by MaxMind, available from https://www.maxmind.com/en/home.

panels.description: Bytes per second across all flow records; buckets are fixed at one minute so the per-second rate is exact.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS time, sum(bytes) / 60 AS traffic FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: WAN traffic

panels.description: Flow records received per second from the gateway.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS time, count() / 60 AS flows FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Flows

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS time, proto AS protocol, sum(bytes) / 60 AS traffic FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time, protocol ORDER BY time

panels.description: Source addresses ordered by volume; on a WAN-only collector this shows remote peers and local hosts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_addr AS source, sum(bytes) AS bytes, sum(packets) AS packets, count() AS flows FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY src_addr ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top source addresses

panels.description: Destination ports ordered by volume; useful for spotting services the homelab reaches externally.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dst_port AS port, count() AS flows, sum(bytes) AS bytes FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY dst_port ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top destination ports

panels.description: Traffic classified by which side of the WAN interface the source address belongs to.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS time, if(src_addr LIKE '10.%', 'lan-source', 'wan-source') AS direction, sum(bytes) / 60 AS traffic FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY time, direction ORDER BY time

panels.title: LAN vs WAN sources

panels.description: Top source-to-destination IP pairs ranked by total bytes during the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_addr AS source, dst_addr AS destination, sum(bytes) AS bytes FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND src_addr != '' AND dst_addr != '' GROUP BY src_addr, dst_addr ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top IP pairs by bytes

panels.description: Top source-to-destination IP pairs ranked by flow count during the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_addr AS source, dst_addr AS destination, count() AS flows FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND src_addr != '' AND dst_addr != '' GROUP BY src_addr, dst_addr ORDER BY flows DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top IP pairs by flow count

panels.description: Approximate public source geography. Smaller countries use country markers; larger countries use GeoLite2 city points when the reported accuracy radius is at most the configured limit.

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT value FROM flows.geo_settings WHERE setting = 'city_accuracy_radius_km' LIMIT 1) AS city_accuracy_limit, raw AS (SELECT src_addr AS address, sum(bytes) AS bytes, sum(packets) AS packets, count() AS flows FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND src_addr != '' GROUP BY src_addr), geo AS (SELECT dictGetOrDefault('flows.ip_geo', 'country_code', toIPv6OrZero(address), '') AS lookup, dictGetOrDefault('flows.ip_geo', 'country_name', toIPv6OrZero(address), '') AS country, dictGetOrDefault('flows.ip_geo', 'city_name', toIPv6OrZero(address), '') AS city, dictGetUInt8('flows.ip_geo', 'city_enabled', toIPv6OrZero(address)) AS city_enabled, dictGetUInt16('flows.ip_geo', 'accuracy_radius', toIPv6OrZero(address)) AS accuracy_radius_km, bytes, packets, flows FROM raw) SELECT lookup, country, sum(bytes) AS bytes, sum(packets) AS packets, sum(flows) AS flows FROM geo WHERE lookup != '' AND (city_enabled = 0 OR city = '' OR accuracy_radius_km > city_accuracy_limit) GROUP BY lookup, country ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 100

WITH (SELECT value FROM flows.geo_settings WHERE setting = 'city_accuracy_radius_km' LIMIT 1) AS city_accuracy_limit, raw AS (SELECT src_addr AS address, sum(bytes) AS bytes, sum(packets) AS packets, count() AS flows FROM flows.flow WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND src_addr != '' GROUP BY src_addr), geo AS (SELECT dictGetOrDefault('flows.ip_geo', 'country_code', toIPv6OrZero(address), '') AS country, dictGetOrDefault('flows.ip_geo', 'country_name', toIPv6OrZero(address), '') AS country_name, dictGetOrDefault('flows.ip_geo', 'city_name', toIPv6OrZero(address), '') AS city, dictGetFloat64('flows.ip_geo', 'latitude', toIPv6OrZero(address)) AS latitude, dictGetFloat64('flows.ip_geo', 'longitude', toIPv6OrZero(address)) AS longitude, dictGetUInt16('flows.ip_geo', 'accuracy_radius', toIPv6OrZero(address)) AS accuracy_radius_km, dictGetUInt8('flows.ip_geo', 'city_enabled', toIPv6OrZero(address)) AS city_enabled, bytes, packets, flows FROM raw) SELECT country, country_name, city, latitude, longitude, accuracy_radius_km, sum(bytes) AS bytes, sum(packets) AS packets, sum(flows) AS flows FROM geo WHERE country != '' AND city_enabled = 1 AND city != '' AND accuracy_radius_km <= city_accuracy_limit GROUP BY country, country_name, city, latitude, longitude, accuracy_radius_km ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 100
